DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Methemoglobinemia (likely secondary to premature birth and placental insufficiency).

The clinical picture of apnea and anemia, coupled with normal cardiac workup and normal Coombs/G6PD tests, points away from structural heart disease or hemolysis. The history of prematurity and placental insufficiency increases the risk for methemoglobinemia, which causes functional anemia (reduced oxygen delivery) and can present with cyanosis that is refractory to oxygen therapy. I am requesting a Blood Methemoglobin Level to confirm this diagnosis.
